content: कुः {%f.%} .²1 The earth; <ls>Śi. 19. 17</ls>. .²2 The base of a triangle or any plane figure; कुः पृथ्वी, कुः कुचं कूलम् … . <ls>Enm.</ls>

कु {%ind.%} A prefix implying ‘badness’, ‘deterioration’, ‘depreciation’, ‘sin’, ‘reproach’, ‘littleness’, ‘want’, ‘deficiency’, <ab>&c.</ab> Its various substitutes are कद् (कदश्व), कव (कवोष्ण), का (कोष्ण), किं (किंप्रभुः); <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Pt. 5. 17</ls>.
कु I. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (कवते) To sound. --II. €6 <ab>Ā.</ab> (कुवते) .²1 To moan, groan. .²2 To cry. --III. €2 <ab>P.</ab> (कौति) To hum, coo (as a bee.) … कुवत्पक्षिकुलाकुलाः <ls>Bk. 9. 1</ls>.
